content.title: Block Party Trailer Rentals
content.summary: The City of Arvada offers free Block Party Trailer rentals to residents and registered neighborhood groups to facilitate community gatherings. Reservations can be made online on a first-come, first-served basis from June through October, with each neighborhood allowed one reservation per year. A Block Party Permit is required if the event involves street closures or public parks, and renters are responsible for the equipment during the rental period.
content.body:
![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=4385)Block parties are a great way to get to know your neighbors and strengthen bonds. The City of Arvada offers free Block Party Trailer rentals rentals to help make your neighborhood gathering a success.

**The Block Party Trailer is available to Arvada residents and registered neighborhood groups only.**Not sure what enrolling in a neighborhood group entails? [Learn more on the Neighborhood Programs webpage](/482/Neighbors-Connected). Neighborhood Leaders who attended Neighborhood Leader Network meetings in 2025 received priority access to the 2026 Block Party Trailer reservation calendar. Interested in attending Neighborhood Leader Network meetings? [Check out our webpage to learn when the next meeting is](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1096/Neighborhood-Leader-Network)!

## The Block Party Trailer reservation calendar is now live for ALL Neighborhood Leaders.

[Reserve the Trailer](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog)

## Block Party Trailer Rentals

- [Access the reservation calendar](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog) on CivicRec, our reservation platform, to select your preferred date.
- Each neighborhood group can reserve the Trailer once per year.
- Reservations for the Block Party Trailer must be made online.
- All Block Party Equipment rentals are **free** and can be reserved online on a first-come, first-served basis.
- Equipment is available to rent from June through October. Reservations may be made Thursdays - Saturdays only. **Please Note**: Thursday and Friday reservations run from 2 p.m. to 11 a.m. the next day. Saturday reservations will be a two-day reservation beginning at 2 pm to 11 am the following Monday.

### Additional Information

- The renter assumes responsibility for equipment rented throughout the duration of the reservation. Please review our Policies/Procedures in the "Policies and Procedures" tab below.
- Curious about what's included in the Block Party Trailer rental? See the information in the "What's Included" tab below.

## Need a Block Party Permit?

- If you plan to close your street or hold your event in a public park, you will be required to complete a [Block Party Permit application](https://www.arvadaco.gov/484/Neighborhood-Block-Party-Permit) at least two weeks in advance of your scheduled event. If your event will be held on private property, you do **not** need to fill out a permit application.

## Reserving Equipment Online

Before reserving equipment on our reservation platform please review the instructions below:

- View the [Block Party Trailer Step-by-Step Instructions](/DocumentCenter/View/5864/Block-Party-Trailer-Rental-Instructionsdocx)
- Visit the [Block Party Trailer Reservation Calendar](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog).

## Questions

[Reach out to the Neighborhood Engagement Team.](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#82ece7ebe5eae0edf0eaedede6f1c2e3f0f4e3e6e3acedf0e5)

## Block Party Trailer Policies and Procedures

When you rent the Block Party Trailer, you assume responsibility for the following:

- I am responsible for the cost for any and all repairs for any damage or replacement of items in the Block Party Trailer while it is in my possession.
- As the individual reserving the Block Party Trailer, I must:
  - Be the party host/organizer.
  - Be enrolled in Neighbors Connected in order to reserve the trailer. If not yet enrolled, visit arvada.org/neighborhoods to apply.
  - Be a resident or property owner in the City of Arvada.
  - Be responsible for the Block Party Trailer and its contents from the time the Applicant receives notification of its delivery through the time the trailer is picked up by Arvada Rent-Alls.
  - Complete a Block Party Permit two weeks in advance of the scheduled event at arvada.org/blockpartypermit if planning to close a street or utilize a City park.
- All items in the Block Party Trailer must be cleaned with disinfectant wipes before and after each use. Public health guidelines for COVID-19 must be followed.
- The trailer must be legally parked on the street and not a private driveway.
- The trailer must be used for free neighborhood events/block parties/gatherings only and not for private events.
- All events using the trailer must be inclusive, open, and accessible to all nearby neighbors.
- The condition of the Block Party Trailer and all its contents upon pick-up by Arvada Rent-Alls is accounted for in the check-list and is the same condition as they were in at the time of drop-off, including but not limited to:
  - All tables, chairs, and coolers cleaned or rinsed out.
  - Removal of any and all trash and surfaces cleaned with disinfectant wipes.
  - Trash and recycling bins have been provided, however, the party host is responsible for proper disposal of all trash and recycling items.
  - All games and pieces returned to their designated boxes and bins.
- I agree to be present at the time of pick-up and also agree to participate in an inventory upon pick-up.
- Doors to the Block Party Trailer are to be secured and locked at all times when the trailer is not in use.
- I agree that any use of the Block Party Trailer for any purpose not consistent with these Policies and Procedures or the Neighbors Connected program may result in loss of my future use of the Block Party Trailer.

## Block Party Trailer Checklist

All items must be cleaned with disinfectant wipes before and after each use.

### Block Party Trailer

- Tables
- Chairs
- Traffic Barricades
- Solid Wood XL Stackers (Jenga blocks)
- Ring Toss
- Plastic bowling set
- LED frisbee
- Frisbee
- Cornhole
- Football
- Volleyball
- Basketball
- Handball
- Spikeball set
- Light up lawn darts
- UNO
- Deck of cards

---

### Outdoor Movie Equipment Discontinued

The outdoor movie equipment is no longer available for use. Join your family and friends for the Arvada Festivals Commission Movies Around Town series on Friday nights throughout the summer. Movies are shown on our giant inflatable movie screen at different Arvada parks each month. [Visit the Festivals' schedule of events webpage for 2025 dates, locations and movies](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1269/Schedule-of-Events)!
